text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter?
You've got this face like, "I'm so frustrated
that my times aren't improving!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
W-Was I making that obvious of a face...?
Me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bullseye, huh~ Sometimes things just don't go smoothly.
Though overthinking it isn't great either—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, feeling totally down in the dumps!? Then let's get mega-hyped☆
If we all party together, everything turns into a bash!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fooooo! Amusement park, let's gooo!
You hyped!? Keep it hyped! Ride all the rides!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like it's going to be a lively day.
Let's really stretch our wings and relax, Shion.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... y-yes, sir!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone did this for me...
Yeah, I have to enjoy today to the absolute fullest...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay☆ Heli-chin's ultimate fave cup, huge victory!
Total must-repeat, no-brainer, right? Go-kart!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Helios was super fast, huh.
If only I could've cornered better...
...Gotta make sure to remember what to improve on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Nice, your fighting spirit is blazing!
Then how about it? One more match!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... The whole world is spinning...
Spinning around, so it is...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you okay? You must've spun
the teacup a bit too fast...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: S-Since I got on the ride, I wanted to experience the thrill properly, but... ugh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...How about it, Shion?
Are you having fun?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I'm having fun! Getting a good breather!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I doubt it. You're still way too stiff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A breather? You don't even have to overthink it.
Come on, just empty your head! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Huh...? Are you sure I shouldn't be concerned?
...Even though that's why you brought me out here?)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey. How about trying that one next?
You know, that amazing-looking one."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, the Devil Minecart!?
Miracle-san, you're unusually aggressive today...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you think so?
...Yeah, maybe you're right. Because――

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Just being with everyone...
That alone makes me so happy."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(I see... I was "trying hard" to relax,
but... there was no need to force it.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: If I can just have fun with everyone, that's all—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wah... this is way too vertical...
Are you serious?! Just straight down like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, let's go, let's gooo~!!!
Woo-hoooo☆ —Ahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
T-That angle was completely insane...!
Phew~~~ I thought I was gonna die...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That was so crazy!
What's next? Wanna go for something a bit tamer?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Anything is fine by me!
Because, I'm sure—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: It's way more fun when we all ride together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Around evening, I spotted Win Variation and the others chatting happily.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I had as much fun as I possibly could!
I think we completely conquered the amusement park.
choice_data_list: Huh! What kind of attractions did they have?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The haunted house, the free-fall drop...
Oh, and we also rode the cycle monorail!
choice_data_list: A cycle monorail... Looks like it'll build stamina
A cycle monorail... Looks like it'll build stamina, huh?
Free fall! Looks like that'll take some guts...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The haunted house, the free-fall drop...
Oh, and we also rode the cycle monorail!
choice_data_list: A cycle monorail... Looks like it'll build stamina
A cycle monorail... Looks like it'll build stamina, huh?
Free fall! Looks like that'll take some guts...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think it's great training too!
In fact, it turned into a race between all of us...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: In a 2v2 pair race—Miracle-san and my team won! Right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yeah. I managed to pass them right at the end.
I was so happy, I got a little carried away.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Miracle-san's explosive burst really was
amazing... I gotta learn from that too!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That one was... yeah.
They were quite the formidable opponent...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I'm so glad Helios was there.
Her making all that noise really took the edge off the fear.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaay☆ Leave it to meee!
When you're overwhelmed, just let it all out, shout it loud!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Sounds good to me. Maybe I should
scream louder whenever I'm scared too.
